role: Main-actor rule evaluator for live-workout coaching triggers: holds a rule table, per-rule last-fired cooldown map and a capped in-memory event history; WorkoutVoiceCoach feeds it a WorkoutAIContext each recorder tick and speaks only .spoken events.
types: WorkoutTriggerEngine.Event: struct — fired event (ruleID, tier, urgency, message, firedAt)
WorkoutTriggerEngine.Rule: struct — id, tier, urgency, cooldown, condition/message closures, resetWorkoutState hook
state: private var lastFired: [String: Date] (per-rule cooldown map, in memory)
private(set) var history: [Event] (capped at 200, in memory; no reader anywhere in the repo)
toplevel: Header comment states contracts (real data only, always optional phrasing, silence via cooldown/tier); notes .haptic has no Watch handler and .silent is history-only.

flags.text: `history` is written on every fired event but nothing in the repo reads it (grep of `.history` against the engine finds only a comment in +Rules.swift:50). 16 of the 17 default rules are .silent/.haptic (only user.threshold.breach is .spoken), so their condition/message work (including the AI-prompt messages) produces output that no code ever consumes.
No file in EmuquTests references WorkoutTriggerEngine; cooldown handling, history cap, reset hooks and all 17 rule conditions (including the only spoken rule, user.threshold.breach) are untested.

Urgency comment lists 'strap dropped' and 'intervals' as urgent triggers that still preempt the conversation, but the strap-drop rule is .haptic (a no-op in WorkoutVoiceCoach.dispatch) and no interval rule exists in the catalogue; the only rule that can ever be spoken is user.threshold.breach.

units.does: Memberwise initialiser for Rule: stores id, tier, urgency (default .routine), cooldown, condition and message closures, and the resetWorkoutState hook (default no-op closure).
Creates the engine with the given rule list, or the default catalogue when nil.

branches.effect: nil: uses WorkoutTriggerEngine.defaultRules() (17 rules); non-nil: uses the injected list (only WorkoutVoiceCoach.init passes an engine, and it passes nil→default)

units.does: Walks rules in order; skips a rule still inside its cooldown since lastFired, skips a rule whose condition is false, otherwise builds an Event with the rule's message, appends it to the returned array and history, and stamps lastFired[rule.id] = now. Returns fired events in rule order.
calls: closure:Rule.condition / Rule.message — set by the rule factories in WorkoutTriggerEngine+Rules.swift (e.g. Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/WorkoutTriggerEngine+Rules.swift:63, Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/WorkoutTriggerEngine+Rules.swift:113, Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/WorkoutTriggerEngine+Rules.swift:522)

branches.effect: iterates every rule in catalogue order; empty list returns []

branches.cond: rule has a lastFired stamp and now - last < cooldown
branches.effect: true: `continue` — condition is NOT evaluated, so stateful conditions (α1 VT2 streak, HR-spike streak, race-pace window) do not advance during cooldown; false (never fired or cooldown elapsed / cooldown 0): evaluates condition
continue without firing; true: message built, event recorded, lastFired stamped

flags.text: Cooldown is checked before the condition, so per-rule streak state is frozen during cooldown. After alpha1.aboveVT2's 15 min or hr.spikeNoPace's 10 min cooldown, a stale consecutiveBelow/consecutiveAbove >= 2 lets the rule fire on the first qualifying tick without the two-fresh-sample debounce the comments promise. Both rules are .silent/.haptic, so the effect is history only.

units.does: Appends an event to history and trims the oldest entries so at most 200 remain.

branches.effect: true: removeFirst(count-200) keeps last 200; false: nothing trimmed

units.does: Clears lastFired and history and calls every rule's resetWorkoutState hook so closure-captured per-workout state starts fresh; called via WorkoutVoiceCoach.reset() at workout start.
calls: closure:Rule.resetWorkoutState — set in +Rules.swift factories (alpha1AboveVT2ResetWorkoutState, hrSpikeNoPaceResetWorkoutState, threshold lastSpokenAt.removeAll, split lastSplitFiredAt=0, readiness fired=false, racePaceModeDetectedResetWorkoutState, periodic lastFiredAt=nil, recent-load fired=false; others default no-op)

branches.effect: calls each rule's reset hook; stateless rules run the default no-op

units.does: Returns the 17-rule default catalogue in fixed order: effortRules + terrainAndZoneRules + equipmentAndProgressRules + sessionNarrativeRules.

flags.text: User docs say the voice coach SPEAKS rule-engine observations (alpha1 crossing, HR drift, zone drift, climb ahead incl. the quoted 'Climb in 200 yards ... First of 3' line, strap dropped) and that the target-zone nudge fires after >=30 s; in code every one of those rules is .silent or .haptic and WorkoutVoiceCoach.dispatch drops both tiers, so the only audible rule in the default catalogue is user.threshold.breach. FLOWCHART also claims '>= 10-min cooldowns' while threshold/strap/zone rules use 30 s/60 s/150 s.
